caseName: Kansas Gas & Electric Co. v. McPherson
caseNameFull: Kansas Gas & Electric Co. v. McPherson
attorneys: Messrs. Henry L. McCune and Blatchford Downing for appellant. Messrs. William Drennan, J. Rodney Rhoades, and Claude I. Depew for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion of the appellees to dismiss the appeal is granted and the appeal is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question. Springfield Gas Co. v. Springfield, 257 U. S. 66; Puget Sound Co. v. Seattle, 291 U. S. 619, 624, 625.
